header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
Mr. Farhan Ahmed Bozdar, advocate for the petitioner
body: Through this petition, the petitioner is only seeking protection against harassment of respondent No.6.
Learned A.A.G submits that protection shall be provided to the petitioner in accordance with law.
In view of the above, this petition is disposed of with directions to the official respondents to provide protection to the petitioner, as and when required, in accordance with law.
